suiteNotes: Glass-forward contemporary suites; balcony and exposure drive lifestyle as much as interior square footage. Compare fee schedules tightly with neighbouring Mattamy and Conservatory product.

neighbourhood.intro: Skylofts II at Mystic Pointe at 200 Manitoba St sits in Mimico, one of South Etobicoke’s most watched waterfront condo pockets. Mimico blends an older lakeside village feel with loft and mid-rise living near Lake Shore Blvd W. Buyers get waterfront trail access, neighbourhood schools, and a slightly quieter pace than the densest Humber Bay towers, while still staying close to the Gardiner and downtown.

highlights.title: Waterfront and parks
highlights.body: Mimico Waterfront Park, Amos Waites Park, and the broader trail network give residents shoreline walks without needing a car. The lake edge and local greenspace are a big part of why families and downsizers shortlist this pocket.

highlights.title: Village amenities
highlights.body: Independent cafés, restaurants, and everyday services along Lake Shore and into Mimico Village support a neighbourhood lifestyle. Transit and highway access keep the rest of the city close when you need it.

sections.title: Loft character
sections.body: Ceiling height, light, and a softer loft aesthetic set it apart from Humber Bay’s glassy high-rises. Amenities and concierge still support practical condo living.

sections.title: Mystic Pointe context
sections.body: Nearby loft and mid-rise product share the pocket; management and concierge contacts can overlap across Mystic Pointe addresses, confirm for 200 Manitoba specifically.

suiteNotes: Soft-loft layouts reward buyers who care about volume and light. Compare against other Mystic Pointe buildings for fees, parking, and renovation quality.
